target_customer: Consumers seeking stress relief, sleep and relaxation, paying through app subscriptions and in-app purchases
problem: People need quick, simple tools to calm panic and sleep better. Deep Meditate offers short guided meditations, music and sleep aids in a mobile app.
business_model: Consumer mobile app with subscriptions and in-app purchases

founders.name: Advait Saravade
founders.background_notes: Sole founder on the YC page (listed under Former Founders per a directory summary). A Carleton University student link comes from aggregator profiles only, so education is left empty.

competitors.name: Calm
competitors.what: Meditation and sleep app with a paid subscription
competitors.traction_then: More than 40 million downloads and over 1 million paying subscribers, revenue run rate of about 150M USD per the company
competitors.funding_then: 88M USD Series B in February 2019 at a 1B USD valuation, about 116M USD total

competitors.name: Headspace
competitors.what: Meditation app named as the main rival to Calm in 2019 coverage
competitors.traction_then: Not stated in the cited coverage
competitors.funding_then: About 75M USD raised in total per a 2019 report of the Calm round

technical_complexity.rationale: A content and audio app for iOS and Android built by a solo founder, with no novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Meditation content is easy to copy and the market was dominated by funded leaders. Calm and Headspace had strong brands and large content libraries.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The incumbents were already large and well funded in 2019. Deep Meditate stayed small and remains listed on app stores.

market_need_then: Meditation and sleep apps were a proven consumer category by 2019, with Calm reporting more than 1 million paying subscribers. A founder post on Indie Hackers cited by a search summary reported over 1 million completed meditations by March 2020.

branding.domain_note: Uses deepmeditate.com, an exact .com match for the descriptive name.

identity.voice_and_tone: calm, simple language: peace and relaxation through meditation, music and sleep aids

branding.community_and_virality: Indie Hackers and Product Hunt product pages exist; no merch or press about the brand itself was found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name in a category dominated by Calm and Headspace, with no press or community evidence about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Deep Meditate is a solo founder meditation app that entered a category already led by Calm and Headspace. It reports early usage but no verified funding beyond YC, no traction after 2020 and a single listed founder under a former founders heading on the YC page. It appears still published in app stores, so the failure factors reflect stalling against better funded rivals rather than a confirmed shutdown, and the cause of stalling is inferred.
notes: YC lists the batch as Winter 2020, not Summer 2020 as in the shard file. Founding year conflicts: YC says 2019 and Waterloo, aggregators and BetaKit (not opened) say 2018 and Ottawa. Unverified funding: CB Insights 150K USD seed dated 2020-03-17 and FundedIQ about 200K USD, both aggregators, so no round recorded. A Business Insider India article about the YC application could not be fetched (host not allowed). Outcome search found no shutdown, sale or layoffs. The Calm figures are company statements reported by CNBC.
